name: allele_dosage
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

inputs.role: the NMD verdict and truncation, which set the stop allele's factors
the readthrough fraction used in the treated scenarios; only rows whose positive control passed are read
the published MVA missense alleles behind the unstable/inactive branches

parameters.model: per allele, 0.5 x mrna x protein_per_mrna x full_length x specific_activity

assumptions: BubR1 function is proportional to the amount of working protein, and the two alleles add; a missense allele that is merely unstable has normal specific activity once present, which is what forced overexpression of I909T and L1012P showed (PMID 20516114); the readthrough product is half as good as wild type, which is a stated guess and not a measurement
limitations: the child's own BubR1 protein level has never been measured, so every scenario is an arithmetic over other people's alleles; PMID 31738183 is a direct caution against the model's own premise - H/H and H/L1002P mice carry indistinguishable total BubR1 yet differ by 147 days of median lifespan, so total level is not a sufficient predictor of phenotype; the two branches (unstable vs inactive) are not decided by any measurement in this case
validation: the untreated scenarios are checked against published genotypes rather than asserted: the base case lands between the mouse H/H level (~10 %) and the upper lip of the human segregation-fidelity cliff (~13 %), which is where a viable MVA child should land

sources.genomic: the child's own callset, read only as: gene, consequence class, and the coding-sequence offset of the stop, which is used inside build/ to derive the codon and its context. No genomic position appears in any row
sources.clinical: the proband's 8 HPO terms (Challenge_Clinical_Phenotype_1.md), used to decide which adverse-effect axes disqualify a candidate: nephrocalcinosis HP:0000121 against aminoglycoside tubular nephrotoxicity, failure to thrive HP:0001508 and short stature HP:0004322 against chronic parenteral dosing, rhabdomyosarcoma HP:0002859 against agents whose class is cytotoxic or which stabilise oncogenic nonsense transcripts
sources.public: Ensembl REST release 116 (gene model, coding sequence), UniProt O60566 (domains), Toledano et al. Nat Genet 2024 PMID 39174735 supplementary table 3 (measured readthrough), and the BubR1 dosage literature cited per row

columns.total_pct_of_wild_type: percent of the wild-type diploid amount of working BubR1
columns.gain_pct_points: percentage points this scenario's drug adds over the same scenario untreated
columns.nearest_published_genotype: the published genotype whose measured level is closest, as a yardstick only

clinical_framing: research exercise; no row advises for or against giving any drug to any patient
patient_data: none in this file. Sequence-derived facts are stated as codon identity, exon index, counts and fractions; no genomic position and no run of patient sequence appears
